answer: Price admission by congestion, not a flat fee. Each new identity posts a bond that rises super-linearly with how many identities recently joined from the same funding or network cluster, so a sudden plume of sign-ups drives its own cost skyward while a lone honest joiner pays almost nothing. The nectar of rewards unlocks only after bonded work clears peer checks, and minting a thousand at once opens a canyon of up-front cost no single operator can cheaply bridge. Sybils punish themselves by their own volume; an honest trickle stays cheap.
